edgar_concentrations.excerpt: We have limited ability to monitor these third parties’ security measures or the full impact of the systemic risk, and concentration with a limited number of providers increases our exposure to outages and pricing changes. If any third-party system or cloud platform that we use is unavailable to us for any reason, our customers may experience service interruptions, which could significantly impact our operations, reputation, business, and financial results. Failure of our systems or those of our third-party service providers, may result in interruptions in our service and loss of data or processing capabilities, all of which may cause a loss in customers, refunds to be sought with respect to product fees, and/or material harm to our reputation and operating results. While certain of our businesses have experienced temporary disruptions, management has not identified any material impact on the Company from such disruptions to date. 28 Global cybersecurity threats are rapidly evolving and attacks to identities, networks, platforms, systems, and endpoints can range from uncoordinated individual attempts to sophisticated and targeted measures known as advanced persistent threats, directed at the Company, its businesses, its customers, and/or its third-party service providers, including, but not limited to, cloud providers and providers of network management services. These may include such things as unauthorized access, phishing attacks, denial of service, insider threats, data exfiltration and extortion, introduction of malware or ransomware, and other disruptive problems caused by threat actors. Threat actors are increasingly targeting trusted software providers, managed service providers, cloud platforms, software repositories, identity providers, developer tools, and other third-party technology ecosystems used by enterprises to develop, host, authenticate, and deploy software and services. Threat actors are also increasingly using AI to automate cyberattacks, enhance phishing and business email compromise campaigns, create convincing synthetic media, accelerate malware development, identify software vulnerabilities, and evade traditional security controls. As these capabilities continue to evolve, they may increase the frequency, sophistication, and effectiveness of attacks directed at the Company, its customers, and its third-party service providers. We face emerging risks from AI-powered attacks, including deepfakes used to impersonate employees or customers, AI-assisted social engineering and hacking activity, prompt injection attempts against AI systems, and data poisoning targeting machine learning models.

columns.2Y 驗證點: 合併有機成長維持 5-6%、旗艦淨留存 ≥93%
columns.5Y 驗證點: 留存 ≥90%、無旗艦垂直被 AI-native 對手系統性搶客
columns.10Y 驗證點: 核心垂直仍為該行標準系統，AI 為加值層非替代
columns.來源: 公司法說（Q1 2026）+ 產業（Gartner 垂直 AI）
columns.漂移觸發: 連 2 季 TTM 有機 <4% → 削弱

rows.text: M&A 飛輪持續：大型 Tier-1 交易 cash-on-cash 維持約雙位數，不向 WACC 崩塌

columns.2Y 驗證點: 年度部署 ~$2-4B，揭露交易 ROIIC ≥ WACC
columns.5Y 驗證點: 累積 M&A 增量 NOPAT/投入 ≥ 10-12%
columns.10Y 驗證點: 飛輪未被「越來越貴的下一筆」吃掉；槓桿 ≤3x
columns.來源: 公司揭露 + 賣方（PE 出價競爭）
columns.漂移觸發: 年度 ≥2 筆大型交易出價落敗，或揭露 ROIIC < WACC → 削弱

rows.text: 市場對「高品質軟體 vs 中速槓桿 rollup」的重定性部分修復（15x → ~17-18x fwd）

columns.5Y 驗證點: 倍數穩定於 17-19x（peer/自身歷史下緣）
columns.10Y 驗證點: 不再被永久打「conglomerate 折價」
columns.數字門檻: Fwd P/E ≥16x 且 EPS 兌現
columns.漂移觸發: Fwd P/E 至 2027 仍困 <13x → 反轉（永久重定性）

rows.text: AI-native 垂直軟體挑戰者（Onit/Applied Systems/新創潮）在旗艦垂直搶客 → 留存/定價侵蝕

columns.監測指標: 旗艦淨留存、法律/保險垂直份額
columns.警戒閾值: 任一旗艦淨留存 <90% 或公開丟標竿客戶

rows.text: Deltek/GovCon 結構性永久降速（DOGE、聯邦採購凍結）+ DAT 貨運長弱

columns.監測指標: Deltek/DAT 有機成長、聯邦撥款能見度
columns.警戒閾值: Deltek 有機至 FY2026 底仍為負且無回穩

rows.text: 大型 Tier-1 M&A 被 PE dry powder 抬價 → cash-on-cash 向 WACC 收斂；槓桿見頂限制飛輪

columns.監測指標: 交易 ROIIC、ND/EBITDA、出價落敗次數
columns.警戒閾值: 年度 ≥2 筆大交易落敗，或揭露 ROIIC < WACC，或 ND/EBITDA >3.5x

triggers.text:
§15｜複審觸發與保質期

# | 重新評估觸發點 | 類型 | 具體時間/條件
1 | Q2 FY2026 財報（合併/旗艦有機成長、留存、Deltek 軌跡） | 財報日期 | 2026-07 底（yfinance 動態供給）
2 | 聯邦 FY2027 撥款與 GovCon 採購能見度（Deltek durability） | 產業事件 | ~2026 Q3-Q4
3 | 價位：站回 W104 $483（加碼確認）或跌破 $310（逢低加碼） | 價位觸發 | 持續監測
4 | §3.F Single Thing:任一旗艦淨留存 <90% 或標竿客戶倒向 AI-native（Onit/Applied Systems） | binary event | 季度法說 + 對手 ARR 公告

保質期：2026-10-31（下一次財報 Q3 FY2026 發布前有效；屆時重估 Deltek 軌跡與留存）。
最可能 upside:AI-VMS 恐慌如 CSU 般退潮 + Deltek 觸底 → Fwd P/E re-rate 至 18-20x + EPS 複利雙擊。
最可能 downside:AI-native 在單一旗艦垂直搶客使留存鬆動 + 大盤軟體 de-rating → 倍數壓至 10-11x。
